svg.title: Suraj x Minutus - The 3-Month Journey
svg.desc: Pixel-art game map of Suraj's journey at Minutus Computing from May 14 to Aug 19 2026: 3DXLens, RCA engine, trailer and waitlist, 3DXInsights, RCA mining, 7B QLoRA fine-tuning on SageMaker, and MinuTasks MCP automation.
svg.text: ▶ GOOD JOB, SURAJ! THE NEXT LEVEL IS WAITING...
